newsitem.title: USA: MHM Services Inc says court affirms award.
newsitem.headline: MHM Services Inc says court affirms award.

text.p: MHM Services Inc said Wednesday the Delaware Supreme Court has upheld a $457,000 lower court judgment on its behalf against Horizon Mental Health Management Inc.
The case involved MHM's right to about $376,000 in connection with the sale to Horizon of MHM's 27.5 percent interest in a joint venture in March 1995, MHM said.
The venture was to provide contract management psychiatric services to Horizon for $9.7 million, MHM said.
Horizon withheld about $376,000 from MHM after the sale -- a portion of the excess cash held by the joint venture -- claiming that MHM was not entitled to it after having sold its interest, MHM said.
The Chancery Court of Delaware found in MHM's favor on October 3, 1996, and this finding was affirmed by the Delaware Supreme Court on May 12, 1997, MHM said.
MHM said it will take a one-time earnings gain to reflect this award in the third quarter ending June 30, 1997. The total award represents the original amount plus accrued interest.
The company said its expects payment within a few weeks.
